body.name: SCC-local stable enumerator
body.construction: \(\mathsf{Enum}(W)\) computes \(\operatorname{SCC}(B)\), enumerates each block's admissible perfect matchings by alternating-cycle recursion, normalizes each matching, certifies Schur stability by the exact rational Lyapunov equation, retains each stable local assignment once, and streams their Cartesian products in lexicographic component order.
